auditor: independent AI auditor (did not write the paper); a fresh one for every round

audits.summary: All paper numbers trace to tables and compare CSVs, all 112 registry rows have commands and logs whose final lines match the registry, and two main-group runs re-executed bit-identically. The code matches the described method, the no-warmup baseline confound is disclosed and ablated, and the refuted and mixed results are stated plainly; only minor wording, citation-scope and stale-file issues remain. The only workspace change from the audit is the checked_at timestamp that the mandated rh lit verify rewrote in paper/citations.json.

findings.issue: The claim that gaps at 'high peak rates' are mostly a warmup effect rests on warmup variants run only at 1e-2; none were run at 3e-2.
findings.fix: Say 'at 1e-2' or add warmup variants at 3e-2.

findings.issue: 'Each run takes roughly 90-120 seconds' does not match logged durations of 40-489 s with median 82 s.
findings.fix: Report the actual range and median from the registry.

findings.issue: Says the test follows research.yaml, which specifies a paired test, but reports the unpaired Welch p=0.0014 (paired p=0.010, same conclusion); 'cosine wins by -0.15 and -0.73 nats' has a confusing sign.
findings.fix: Report the paired p or note the deviation; state gaps as positive magnitudes.

findings.issue: 'For GPT-style models, [kalra2024why] study...' mis-scopes Kalra & Barkeshli, whose abstract describes general SGD/Adam experiments rather than a GPT study; only Kosson et al. is GPT-specific.
findings.fix: Move the 'GPT-style' qualifier to Kosson et al. only.

findings.issue: 'Rankings between schedules are known to change with training length' is a prior-work claim with no citation.
findings.fix: Add a citation or soften to 'may change'.

findings.issue: The decay contribution (1.68 vs 1.81) and H3 against the registered 100-step default are cross-group comparisons with no test; the latter is disclosed and both effects are far larger than the seed spread.
findings.fix: Compute a Welch test across groups from runs.jsonl and report it.

findings.issue: Stale: predates the regrouping, lists only three tasks and shows ablations as 'missing', while rh check now also reports losses at lr3e-4 and lr3e-2.

The group field of 36 rows was hand-edited after logging (sweep_lr/sens to main) with metrics unchanged and verified against logs; the paper says they 'are logged in' group main, and sensitivity rows for baselines carry kind=method.
findings.fix: Say the rows were relabelled into main after logging and correct the kind field.

findings.issue: Author URL overflows the right margin; Fig. 2 has y-label 'value' and raw legend names; p-values from n=3 are printed to four significant figures.
findings.fix: Shorten or wrap the URL, relabel the figure, round p-values.
